name: South Carolina

cover_rules: SC 340: to reduce wind erosion, time cover crop establishment with other practices so the soil is protected in critical erosion periods.
SC 340: aim for a minimum of 90-percent combined canopy and surface residue cover during the period of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
windbreak: SC 380: the protected zone leeward of a windbreak is 10 times the design height; place windbreaks in a series at intervals of 5 to 20 times height, perpendicular to prevailing winds.
roughening: SC 588: cross wind ridges are formed by tillage or planting, aligned perpendicular to prevailing wind during critical wind erosion periods.

coverPlant.text: SC 340: warm-season cover crop planting windows are Coastal Plain April 15 - June 1, Piedmont May 1 - June 15, Mountains May 15 - June 15.
SC 340: cool-season cover crop planting windows are Coastal Plain Sept 15 - Oct 15, Piedmont Aug 25 - Oct 1, Mountains Jul 25-Sept 15.
